proof_body:
by
  intro c
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => c * y) c 0 := ((hasDerivAt_id' (0 : ℝ)).const_mul c).congr_deriv (by ring)
  constructor
  · have hd : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (c * x)) c 0 := h.exp.congr_deriv (by simp)
    refine (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hd).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    simp [slope_def_field]
  · have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => 1 + c * y) c 0 := h.const_add 1
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (1 + c * x)) c 0 := (h1.log (by simp)).congr_deriv (by simp)
    refine (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hd).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    simp [slope_def_field]
target_source: ∀ (c : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Real.exp (c * x) - 1) / x) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds c) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (1 + c * x) / x) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds c)
